title: NGS 02/2025 SOR and Final Decision Consultation on Liquefied Natural Gas Transfer Operations Regulations
text:
URCA is responsible for licensing NGS activities in The

Bahamas in addition to issuing regulations and guidelines that aim to promote the development

and functioning of a safe and reliable natural gas system in The Bahamas. URCA regulates the

NGS through the Natural Gas Act, 2024 (NGA) which sets out, inter alia, URCA’s powers and

obligations in relation to the NGS.

The document can be found here: NGS 02/2025 SOR and Final Decision
